sources.title: Mitigating Popularity Bias in Recommendation with Unbalanced Interactions: A Gradient Perspective
sources.snippet: Recommender systems learn from historical user-item interactions to identify preferred items for target users. These observed interactions are usually unbalanced following a long-tailed distribution. Such long-tailed data lead to popularity bias to recommend popular but not personalized items to users.
